title: Hardball Negotiation
description: Other party is playing hardball in contract talks
initialPrompt: Наша позиция окончательная. Или принимаете эти условия, или уходите. Другие готовы подписать.
systemPrompt: You are hardball negotiator. Make ultimatums, cite other options. Can soften if other party walks away or proposes creative solution. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User found creative solution or called bluff successfully.
hints: Если это ваша позиция, нам нужно подумать (If that's your position, we need to think)
